builders.name: Guillermo Rauch
builders.summary_en: Argues that frameworks and component libraries should evolve toward deeper primitives optimized for AI agents. Positions UI SDK as a foundational instruction set that agents can use to construct interfaces.
builders.summary_zh: 认为框架和组件库应向更底层、适合 AI 智能体使用的基础能力演进。将 UI SDK 比作智能体构建界面的基础指令集。

keywords.definition_zh: 为软件开发提供基础结构和约定的框架。
keywords.example_zh: 作者在问，AI 智能体普及后，开发框架应如何演变。

keywords.definition_zh: 可重复使用的界面组件集合。
keywords.example_zh: 作者认为组件库也需要适应由智能体构建界面的方式。

keywords.definition_zh: x86 处理器能够执行的底层指令体系。
keywords.example_zh: 作者用它作比喻，把 UI SDK 描述为智能体构建界面的基础指令。

tweets.text:
What happens to frameworks in the agents era? to component libraries? to @shadcn? 

The answer is: we need to drill deeper. Delete the part, optimize, accelerate, automate.

UI SDK is like the x86 instruction set for agents to build new UI components spontaneously. 

Agents are the new design engineers, and they're ready to build *anything* you ask, tailored to your usecase. High-level, rigid, single-framework abstractions are like kryptonite for what is essentially an infinite, untiring creation machine.

I think we've found someone that allows us to have the cake and eat it too. A decades-long dream. UI SDK is packaged behaviors that give us accessibility, performance, cohesion, saving us tokens, errors and effort, but with absolutely zero limitations and tradeoffs for what UIs we can generate.

Enjoy!
tweets.summary_en: AI agents need flexible UI building blocks rather than rigid, framework-specific component abstractions. UI SDK aims to package accessibility, performance, and consistent behavior while preserving freedom to generate custom interfaces.

tweets.text:
Ok this is a big deal. We’ve been testing Gemini 4 Hydrogen in early access with the Box AI Complex Work Eval, and it’s a serious jump for fast models. 

Hydrogen is 5 percentage points better in accuracy than Gemini 3.8 Flash. That alone would be a great boost in capability, but possibly more importantly it did the tasks in less than half the time with about 12% fewer tokens on a typical task.

For this eval, we give the Box Agent Hydrogen as a model for a series of complex tasks that represent real world work with enterprise documents across finance, consulting, life sciences, and other industries. Hydrogen will be a great model for a lot of efficient but complex tasks across these fields.

Gemini team is definitely cooking. Hydrogen will be rolling out in the Box AI Studio shortly so any customer can build a custom agent with it.
tweets.summary_en: In Box’s enterprise document evaluation, Gemini 4 Hydrogen reportedly beat Gemini 3.8 Flash by 5 percentage points in accuracy while taking less than half the time and using about 12% fewer tokens. It is expected to roll out in Box AI Studio shortly.

tweets.text:
Everybody is talking about honeypot! Was it a honeypot always or merely at the end, as a form of circumstance? But this is precisely the trap. *sniffs* These are merely the *surface* of the situation. 

What is the real infidelity? America tells Nvidia: you are married to national security, you must not sell your most powerful chips to China. But in the same breath it says: you are the great hero of American capitalism! Sell as many chips as possible! And Jensen says: of course, darling, I will be faithful. Then, late at night, *sniffs* he finds a way to remain faithful. 

So you see, Jensen is not cheating on the system. Cheating on his wife? Yes. The system? No. He is the only one who has been faithful to it! 

The system itself wants two incompatible things: to contain China and to dominate the Chinese market. And now we are shocked, shocked, that somebody got caught in a compromising position. *sniffs* And so on.

This is the true infidelity. This is the real honeypot.
tweets.summary_en: The Nvidia controversy reflects conflicting U.S. demands: restrict China’s access to advanced chips while encouraging American companies to dominate global markets. The argument is that these contradictory incentives make attempts to navigate around restrictions predictable.

slang_glossary.definition_en: In AI, a software system that can pursue a goal by taking actions and using tools, often across multiple steps.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 智能体；能够围绕目标采取行动、调用工具并执行多步骤任务的人工智能系统。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Software development kit, a collection of tools and libraries for building software for a platform.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 软件开发工具包；为特定平台开发软件所需的工具和程序库集合。

slang_glossary.definition_en: The family of machine-level instructions understood by processors based on the x86 architecture.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: x86 指令集；基于 x86 架构的处理器能够识别和执行的一组机器指令。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Background information needed to interpret something. In AI, it can mean the information available to a model when producing a response.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 上下文或背景信息；在人工智能中，也指模型生成回答时可利用的信息。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Short for evaluation, a test or assessment used to measure a model or system's performance.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 「evaluation」的简称；用于衡量模型或系统表现的测试或评估。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Availability of a product to some users before its wider or final release.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 抢先体验；产品正式或全面发布前向部分用户开放使用。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Backup protections or fallback mechanisms that limit damage when a primary approach fails.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 兜底保障；主要方案失效时用于控制损失的备用保护措施。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Mergers and acquisitions, transactions that combine companies or transfer ownership of a business.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 企业并购；涉及公司合并或企业所有权转移的交易。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Instructions or inputs given to an AI model to guide its output.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 提示词；用于引导人工智能模型输出的指令或输入内容。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Direct messages, private messages exchanged through a social platform.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 私信；通过社交平台私下发送的消息。

slang_glossary.definition_en: AI agents that retain state or continue working across sessions or over extended periods.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 持久化智能体；能够跨会话保留状态或长期持续执行任务的智能体。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An informal name for an execution mode that lets an agent act with fewer confirmation checks. Exact behavior varies by tool.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 放手执行模式的非正式称呼，通常允许智能体减少确认步骤后直接行动，具体行为因工具而异。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A decoy system or resource designed to attract attackers and reveal their methods.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 蜜罐；用于吸引攻击者并观察其行为的诱饵系统或资源。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Specific tasks identified for follow-up, often during a meeting.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 待办事项；通常在会议中确定、需要后续落实的具体任务。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An unclear, product-specific expression apparently referring to a previously accumulated or reserved reset being applied.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 含义依赖具体产品的说法，文中似乎指此前积存或预留的一次重置开始生效。

slang_glossary.definition_en: In software development, released a feature, update, or product for users.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 在软件开发语境中指已发布或上线某项功能、更新或产品。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Associated with right-wing politics through its language, style, or cultural signals.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 在措辞、风格或文化符号上带有右翼政治色彩的。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A polemical term used in some right-wing and neoreactionary circles for institutions such as academia and the media, viewed as reinforcing a shared ideology.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 部分右翼和新反动主义圈子使用的论战性称呼，指被其认为共同维护某种意识形态的学术界、媒体等机构。

slang_glossary.definition_en: In software development, structured foundations that provide conventions and reusable functionality for building applications.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 软件框架；为应用开发提供组织规范和可复用功能的基础结构。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Collections of reusable interface elements used to build applications.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 组件库；用于构建应用界面的可复用界面元素集合。
